subject: Should mgcv be in Imports: rather than just Suggests: ?

messages.author: acd6776cd6a7d886
messages.subject: Should mgcv be in Imports: rather than just Suggests: ?
parts:
I have a package that Suggests: ggplot2 for a vignette. I got an email from Prof. Ripley notifying me that my package is currently failing R CMD check because of an unstated dependency on mgcv:

>  Quitting from lines 437-441 (companion-to-sample-file-1314.Rmd) 
>    Error: processing vignette 'companion-to-sample-file-1314.Rmd' failed with diagnostics:
>   there is no package called 'mgcv'
(https://cran.r-project.org/web/checks/check_results_grattan.html)

The failure occurs because I use `geom_smooth()` which in that context invokes mgcv, but mgcv is not listed in Imports: so CRAN does not install it when it installs ggplot2. I know I can just put mgcv in Suggests, but I wonder whether the problem might be with ggplot2.

(Asking here, not on GitHub, because it's a question.)

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Should mgcv be in Imports: rather than just Suggests: ?
parts:
You should put mgcv in suggests, since you're using it.
Hadley
